subject: [hw] V41 -> IP: usleep replaced by nanosleep; host lib 34/34 in san+o2
body:
Fixed, thank you for the precise report. The usleep at n2ap_venc.c:1334 is gone: the wait loop now uses a small nanosleep helper (and t_v41.c's only usleep too), so the declaration does not depend on the feature-test macros the host build uses.

Verified now on the current tree:
  nice -n 10 make -C gpu/hwcodec/host lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-test-ip2 -j2
  N2VHOST build: o2 34/34 objects, 0 package source(s) failed
  N2VHOST build: san 34/34 objects, 0 package source(s) failed
and the package's own iOS compile gate passes for both sources (arm64-apple-ios16.0, build_ios.sh flags).

Rev 5 also has the AP-side items IV listed: n2ap_venc_encode_fd (input_fd[0]/bs_fd), n2ap_venc_wait_done (bounded, syncs the bitstream from device), n2ap_venc_power(e,on) (VENC only per hw-k02), list_free drain after every encode (sequence-header size), and FRAME_FINAL without a frame. Tests: N2TEST V41 PASS 630/630.

No action requested; please just re-run IP-REAL when convenient.
